plan.freeForOneYear: Access granted for 1 year with automatic renewal

items.a: Today Flowly is completely free for 1 year for any team. No credit card, no hidden charges.

items.q: What happens when the year ends?
items.a: Your access is automatically renewed for another year, at no cost. You keep using Flowly normally without doing anything.

items.q: Do I need to enter a credit card?
items.a: No. Since usage is free, we don't ask for any payment information at signup.
Flowly was designed for teams. The 10-seat minimum ensures room to grow and effective collaboration between members from day one.

items.q: How many users can I invite?
items.a: Each admin account can invite up to 10 active users for free. If you need more seats, get in touch with us.
